ck: ranasupa_94 (ra.) (491) tana, vetopaprnhananurtanyataya pavatapinatasrivisnupuranakatena "satpava evan pavato nayokta" iti anupataslokena virutartakapavatapinatasrutyo vyavaharikaparanartika visayataya vyavastakatanena "ko hi ninansaka" iti pavatukte pavatapinatapuranavacanavirutatvat "satyasya satyan prana vE satyan tesanesa satya" ityativyavaharikaparanartika satyatvayapotakasarvapinataprananapavasrutivirutatvaceti yat, kantanan_94 (kan.) tatucan, visnupuranasya vyavaharikaparanartika visayataya srutyorvyavastapakatvapavasyanupatanevoktatvat "satyasya satyan" iti srute caksusascaksu cetananan cetana cyotisan cyoti ityatO yata cyotistavatiprata ityarta tata prananan satyatvaprata ityartakatvena vyavaharikaparanartika visayakatvapotakatvapavasya purvanevoktatvena vyavaha rikaparanartikavastutvaye prananatvapavat srute vyavaharikavastuvisayakatve vyavaharikatva aropitatve ca srutersatitartavisayakatvarupaprananyasya prapte
